title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable Cancellation Entitlement | Flight Renumbered | Same Departure / Same Arrival (0h Delay) | Basic Aeroplan | FOC Crew Code
goal:
Customer's original flight AC 435 YUL?YYZ was CANCELLED due to FOC (Flight Ops Control / Crew � Controllable). Customer is reprotected / rebooked onto renumbered flight AC 445 YUL?YYZ. The renumbered flight departs at the exact SAME scheduled departure time (08:00) AND arrives at YYZ at the exact SAME scheduled arrival time (10:00) as the original promised itinerary (0 hours arrival delay). Passenger holds a Basic Aeroplan profile (9876543210) linked to the booking. Validates: (1) Involuntary reprotection / flight renumbering handling (AC 435 ? AC 445), (2) APPR Controllable Cancellation Entitlement logic � under APPR, a controllable cancellation is a standalone entitlement that yields $400 CAD Cash / $480 CAD AC Wallet floor even when the passenger arrives on time on the reprotected flight, (3) FOC (Flight Ops Control / Crew) classified as Controllable, (4) Linked Basic Aeroplan profile triggers dual payout offer (Cash vs AC Wallet with 20% top-up), (5) Customer selects Cash ($400 CAD via Interac e-Transfer).

Prereuisites:
PNR: TC024 � single passenger Dominique Arsenault (Adult - Basic Aeroplan Member #: 9876543210). Original itinerary: AC 435 YUL?YYZ, Scheduled departure: 08:00, Scheduled arrival: 10:00. Original flight CANCELLED (Cancellation Code: FOC � Flight Ops Control / Crew � Controllable). Customer reprotected on renumbered flight AC 445 YUL?YYZ. Scheduled departure time: 08:00 (SAME as original scheduled departure). Actual arrival time: 10:00 (SAME as original promised arrival � 0h delay). Entitlement: Controllable Cancellation Entitlement Floor ($400 CAD Cash / $480 CAD AC Wallet). Aeroplan: Linked (9876543210), Basic Member in good standing. CyberSource: GREEN. RDS: No flags.
